title: Purchase suggestions
description: Ingredients below minimum and by projected usage (average daily usage over {{lookback}} days × coverage days). Open purchase orders are taken into account.
coverageHint: 0 = only bring stock up to the minimum
noSupplierHint: Set a default supplier on the ingredient to order these items.
empty: All stock levels are fine, nothing to buy.
invalidQuantity: Quantity must be greater than zero.
